title: Functorial infinity localization preserves finite products
statement:
Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], enlarging universes to contain all categories under discussion. A system $W$ on an infinity category $\mathcal C$ is a collection of arrows containing all equivalences and closed under composition and homotopy. Let $\mathsf{WCat}_\infty$ have objects $(\mathcal C,W)$ and mapping spaces the unions of components of $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C,\mathcal C')^{\simeq}$ consisting of functors sending $W$ into $W'$; the superscript denotes the maximal infinity groupoid. Composition is induced by composition of functors. Products have underlying category $\prod_i\mathcal C_i$ and coordinatewise systems $\prod_iW_i$, including the terminal category with its identities for the empty product. Write $G:\mathsf{Cat}_\infty\to\mathsf{WCat}_\infty$ for $G(\mathcal E)=(\mathcal E,\operatorname{Eq}(\mathcal E))$, where $\operatorname{Eq}$ is the collection of equivalences. Then $G$ is fully faithful and has a left adjoint $L$ preserving finite products. Write $L(\mathcal C,W)=\mathcal C[W^{-1}]$ and $\eta_{\mathcal C,W}:(\mathcal C,W)\to G L(\mathcal C,W)$ for its unit. Its underlying functor $q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C[W^{-1}]$ inverts $W$, and for every infinity category $\mathcal E$ restriction gives an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C[W^{-1}],\mathcal E)\simeq\operatorname{Fun}_W(\mathcal C,\mathcal E),$$
where the right side is the full subcategory of functors carrying $W$ to equivalences. In particular the product comparisons $L(\prod_i(\mathcal C_i,W_i))\simeq\prod_i L(\mathcal C_i,W_i)$ are natural, including the empty product.
